column2: Write an apology email to [client name / customer segment] for [describe the mistake — e.g., "sending the wrong file," "missing a deadline by 3 days," "our service was down for 6 hours," "a billing error that charged them twice"]. Take full ownership — no weasel words like "we apologize for any inconvenience." State what happened plainly, explain what caused it (briefly), describe what I've done to fix it, and explain what I'm doing to prevent it from happening again. If appropriate, offer [a discount / credit / free month / bonus] as a goodwill gesture. Under 200 words.
